-- Items and loans (the equipment-loan example, PRD §3.5/5.16): one active loan per item, enforced by the database
-- itself (a unique partial index), not just application code. Forward-only like 0001: fix forward in 0003+.
CREATE TABLE items (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE loans (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'returned')),
  reserved_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  returned_at INTEGER
);
CREATE INDEX loans_item ON loans (item_id);
CREATE INDEX loans_user ON loans (user_id);
-- At most one active loan per item; a second reservation attempt hits this constraint, reported as 409 (TS §12.5).
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX loans_active_item ON loans (item_id) WHERE status = 'active';
